models_evaluated: deep learning glaucoma model for colour fundus photographs (manufacturer threshold 0.73)

links.outcome: Local retrospective performance of AI against specialist reference standard for referable glaucoma
links.effect: Sensitivity 1.00 (95% CI 0.82-1.00), specificity 0.65 (95% CI 0.53-0.75), PPV 0.41 (95% CI 0.27-0.57); would have prevented 36 (37.5%) referrals with no glaucoma cases missed.
links.quote: The model presented high sensitivity (1.00; 95% CI 0.82-1.00), and reasonable specificity (0.65; 95% CI 0.53-0.75) and positive predictive value (0.41; 95% CI 0.27-0.57).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation/simulation of an existing deep learning model applied to real-world clinical cohort data to assess its referral filtering performance without comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
